title: S53 — Hard CAPTCHA generator: synthesize thousands of degraded images for training and testing
desc:
Current limitation: we only have 3 seed images worth of hard cases. The CNN can't learn to read degraded glyphs if it never sees enough examples. S29/S30 showed the wall is image-side — the CNN needs MORE hard training data.

Task: extend generator.py to synthesize 2000 hard CAPTCHAs with controlled degradation patterns: corrosion variations (light/medium/heavy/extreme), rotation variations (mild/moderate/severe/extreme), overlay families (spiderweb/cross-shadow/strippy/darts), and combined degradations. Output: images/ directory + manifest.jsonl with id, label, family, degradation_type, severity.

This data will train the v5 CNN (S30 retrain) and enable benchmarking on 2000 items instead of 100. Owner: cormac. Priority: 1 (critical path to 95%).
